signal_policy: Ordinal signals are -2..2 evidence strengths used only to derive direction. Current target models do not apply the numeric value directly. Every signal must reference same-round archived evidence.
scale: -2..2 ordinal signal; 0 neutral; sign sets evidence direction only

entries.summary: Mercedes showed a repeated Shanghai short-run signal across sole practice and Sprint Qualifying.
The pre-race report described a difficult Red Bull handling state, treated as a race risk signal rather than a direct position call.
